question: Can useful forward exact confluence be separated from return-to-entry borrowing by a generic topology or canonical-state boundary?

controlDeterministicSample.note: 13/32 sampled root->source pairs differ in canonical key only by floorId, retaining all flags including __leaveLoc__

rejectedBoundaries.claimBoundary: Within the tested ancestry/depth/empty-roundtrip gate classes, none separated the observed negative from the known P16 positive; this is not a universal impossibility claim over all state/topology predicates.
rejectedBoundaries.excludeRepresentativeAncestorOfRoot: Both positive examples are also not root descendants; the gate has no principled target.
rejectedBoundaries.representativeParentMustNotBeRootAncesto: P7 passes, but the first real divergence (pop 102) bypasses it; also flips with equally valid canonical parent choice.
rejectedBoundaries.representativeDepthGreaterThanRoot: Admits the first real divergence; also flips with equally valid canonical parent choice.
rejectedBoundaries.banEmptyReturnBorrowing: Removes the first real divergence, but the same state test also removes the real P16 forward confluence that only differs by added TS13 mutations, hero movement and non-floorId canonical deltas.

designModel.openQuestion: Does protected dual-origin bounded service (native local branch vs borrowed branch inside the same K) serve both real examples better than an empty-return ban?

regressionP7Shaped.unrestricted: monopolized by borrowed chain, no goal

counterexamples: Ancestor/depth gates flip under equally valid canonical parent selection for the identical future state.
Naively treating newly registered descendants of borrowed nodes as native loses native local service (model MISS where dual-origin succeeds).
notClaimed: Not a production scheduler and not tested on the real 32k search.
No claim that P16/P7 outcomes would change in the real search.
No weights or service ratios were searched or tuned.

nextStep: PR-5.32h is authorized: implement default-OFF dual-origin bounded service and fixed same-code 32k A/B. Do not change dominance, increase budgets, sweep weights/K, or use topology/state special cases.
